entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.769 +/- 0.026 solar radii from Barros et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 207496 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...673A...4B/abstract); Mass 0.8 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Barros et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 207496 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...673A...4B/abstract); temperature from Barros et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 207496 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,819 K and log g 4.57 (u1 0.707, u2 0.078): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
